title.narrative: Consolidation of the Panama Public Financial Management Information System

description.narrative: The project will support the consolidation of the core public financial management functions, including the integration to the broader PFM ecosystem. Similarly, the project will improve and modernize resource and administration management systems, including payrolls, customs administration, public asset, and investment management systems. The project will strengthen the capabilities of the Ministry of Economy and Finance to monitor, detect and respond to cyberattacks and ensure the continuation of government operations. Finally, the project includes the design and implementation of a comprehensive change management and capacity building strategy that will underpin the reform.
To improve the operational efficiency and quality of information of public financial management in the Republic of Panama
